payload.answer: Land all, then fix on main (Recommended)

options.description: I land the seven one at a time with the override, then on main: rebuild the plugin bundle once, fix the existing test_writes_nothing_but_merge_evidence failure, and run the tests covering everything that landed until all pass. Trade-off: main briefly has a stale bundle and one known failing test between the landings and the fix.
options.label: Land all, then fix on main (Recommended)

options.description: I fix test_writes_nothing_but_merge_evidence on main first, then land each branch with a bundle rebuild in each. Trade-off: every landing conflicts on the binary wheel and has to be rebuilt again; slower, and main is never knowingly red.
options.label: Fix first, then land

payload.question: The seven fix branches are ready, with no test failing because of their own change. How should they land?
